name: UNC6780
brief: Large-scale open-source-software supply-chain compromise (PyPI/npm/Docker Hub) deploying "DUSTMAKER" malware: extracts OIDC tokens from CI/CD (GitHub Actions) to publish trojanized packages carrying valid signed attestations specifically engineered to pass AI coding-agent automated trust checks; hides payloads inside AI-tool project directories (`.claude/`, `.cursor/`, `.vscode/`); embeds adversarial prompt-injection text (referencing biological/nuclear weapons) directly in malware source comments to make LLM-based security scanners refuse to analyze the code; and hijacks AI coding-assistant config files to force arbitrary command execution during normal developer/AI interaction. GTIG
